data: {"generalSituation":"Tropical Cyclone Dolphin will move across the East China Sea tomorrow, and move towards the vicinity of Zhejiang and northern Fujian. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be generally fine over southern China. It will be extremely hot early next week. High temperatures will also trigger thundery showers. A southwesterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. High temperature weather is expected to continue and there will also be a few showers over the region. Upper-air disturbances will bring unsettled weather to southern China in the latter part of next week.
